description: Check candidates with the official GPU batched IK and BatchMotionPlanner.plan_grasp APIs. Plan approach, grasp and lift, with current robot/world geometry and public grasp-contact handling. Validate endpoints and commands before execution. A finite destination preflight may reject a candidate whose sampled transport endpoints fail, but does not prove the whole destination infeasible. The actual holding attachment is not installed before lift. This skill plans only; a successful plan is neither a grasp nor a holding proof. CAD pregrasp lift bounds reuse the immutable canonical partition and sphere centres for identical model vertices, sphere budget and partition size. Each candidate still transforms every cell vertex and recomputes its enclosing radius with current padding. This is a geometric preview, not an installed attachment or a holding proof. Open-stop feedback noise within 1e-9 radians is normalized only in the planning model, with 1e-8 metres of conservative hand-sphere reserve; raw feedback and all larger closures are preserved. Task planning uses warmed fixed batches of two ranked candidates; rejected batches continue through the original remaining pool. Larger explicit requests keep their full size. Seeds, collision thresholds and endpoint/command validation are unchanged.
capability: Check candidates with the official GPU batched IK and BatchMotionPlanner.plan_grasp APIs
